note: Human art approvals are recorded here, in the repository, and never in the player save. An entry means the user saw the artifact and approved its look; it does not mean the engine already draws it.

approvals.note: Covers the look of the five state frame sets and the concept they all share. It does NOT cover in-game art: the engine still draws the procedural rig, which keeps its TEMP tag until these frames are rebuilt into a sprite set and approved as sprites.
